items.title: Claude is accelerating protein design
items.oneliner: Anthropic says Claude hit 35% protein-design success, well above human baselines. AI is moving from chat to wet lab.

items.title: Ornith released new open MIT models
items.oneliner: Ornith shipped MIT-licensed 9B, 35B MoE, and 397B MoE models. Open-weight competition is not slowing down.

items.title: Generalist taught robots from seconds
items.oneliner: Generalist says GEN-1.5 learns tasks from 3 to 12 second demos with 59% success. Robotics is getting less scripted.

items.title: AI-assisted cancer therapy cleared Phase 3
items.oneliner: Merck and Moderna say their AI-assisted personalized cancer vaccine met Phase 3 endpoints. This is clinical AI with consequences.

items.title: Rust supply chain attack executed code
items.oneliner: A compromised arrayref release enabled silent build-time code execution via typosquatted proc-macro1. Cargo trust just got more expensive.

items.title: AliExpress fingerprinting broke Bluetooth audio
items.oneliner: AliExpress was caught running hidden WebAudio fingerprinting that disrupted Bluetooth multipoint. Tracking code is now breaking hardware behavior.

items.title: Rosetta 2 can help pack malware
items.oneliner: Researchers showed Rosetta 2 translation paths can be abused for malware packing. Apple Silicon defenses still have compatibility-era seams.

items.title: Cursor agents now fix pull requests
items.oneliner: Cursor launched cloud agents that iterate on pull request feedback until merge-ready. Code review is becoming an asynchronous agent loop.

items.title: OpenRouter is joining Stripe
items.oneliner: OpenRouter says it is joining Stripe after scaling past 10 trillion daily tokens. Model routing is becoming core infrastructure.

items.title: Australia passed a news payment levy
items.oneliner: Australia passed a levy on tech giants that do not pay local news publishers. Platform regulation now has sharper teeth.
